question: The Strait of Gibraltar connects which of the following Ocean with the Mediterranean Sea and separates Spain on the European continent from Morocco on the African continent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Strait of Gibraltar is a narrow strait that connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea.
 
• It separates southern Spain (Europe) from northern Morocco (Africa).
 
• The strait is one of the busiest maritime passages in the world, crucial for global shipping routes.
 
• Historically, the strait has been of immense strategic and economic importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atlantic Ocean**

 
 
• The Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest ocean in the world, covering approximately 20% of the Earth's surface.
 
• It is bounded by the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.
 
• The ocean plays a crucial role in regulating the global climate and weather patterns.
 
• It is an essential route for international trade and has numerous important shipping lanes.
 
 
 
• **Strait of Gibraltar**
 
 
• The Strait of Gibraltar is about 13 kilometers (8 miles) wide at its narrowest point.
 
• It has been a critical geographical feature for navigation and trade for centuries.
 
• The strait also marks the boundary between the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
 
• It is one of the key routes for oil and gas transportation and other maritime traffic between Europe, Africa, and Asia.
 
 
 
• **Maritime Significance**
 
 
• The Strait of Gibraltar is one of the world's busiest maritime routes, with thousands of ships passing through it annually.
 
• It serves as a passage for vessels traveling between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean, including those from the Suez Canal to the Americas.
 
• The strait's strategic location has made it a focal point for naval operations and maritime security.
